sessions.description: Pandas DataFrame data cleaning & exploratory data analysis

MODULE 2 >> Basic SQL Queries
• Introduction to the SELECT statement
• Filtering data with WHERE clause & logical operators
• Sorting data with ORDER BY (ASC / DESC)

📝 Practice: Solved 15 live database query challenges in MySQL Workbench.

MODULE 9 >> Object Oriented Programming (OOP)
• OOP Introduction: Class and Instance
• Properties v/s Getters and Setters (@property)
• Abstract Classes and Polymorphism

MODULE 12 >> Working with Views & Materialized Views
• Creating and using Standard Views
• Updating data through Updatable Views
• Security considerations & row-level access using Views
• Materialized Views & automatic refresh strategies

MODULE 6 >> Node.js
• What is Node.js? Server-side JavaScript runtime
• Node architecture & single-threaded Event Loop
• NPM & package.json scripts management
• Modules & require() vs ES Modules (import/export)
• File system operations (fs module)
• Streams & buffers for large data
• Event emitter architecture
• Asynchronous programming patterns

MODULE 15 >> Full-Stack Integration
• Connect React frontend with Node/Express REST backend
• State lifting & centralized API services with Axios
• Handling cookies, localStorage, and session persistence
• End-to-end form validations & error UI feedback
Covered Variables, Data Types, and Operators with hands-on lab exercises
